verdict.rationale: AIMA is a government immigration agency's online service portal. Such a service could plausibly expose a public API alongside its UI, so the axis applies. The only evidence is a probe that failed TLS verification before fetching anything, which says nothing about whether an API exists or matches the UI, so there is no evidence of API-to-UI parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
